entries.text: I was helping a guy name Sean, I think he escaped from Providence,  however interestingly in his past he was part of the Mormon Church. I prayed for him, and helped him catch a bus, he has a severe disability and he needs help... I tried to preach the Gospel to him to give him hope but be rejected it, I think partly because he thought I was Mormon, however, he does believe in a God and he's agnostic (because he doesn't believe in Mormon Jesus, but he does believe in God). Meaning he still has room to recieve Jesus, he just rejects the name of Jesus because it was corrupted by the Mormon Church, I ask that we pray for him. I ask that the real Jesus may be present in his life. I pray even if he doesn't understand, that he can find faith in God, He has faith in something, and that faith may be in God, and what I know is we are saved through faith alone, even if we don't understand everything perfectly. So I pray for forgiveness for him, I interceed for a man who has gotten so lost he cannot even distinguish the truth from a lie. I pray that it may be revealed, and he may he forgiven for his sins, and he may find reconciliation. He claimed he was Presbyterian too, meaning he does believe in the God of church, just doesn't equate the name of that God to Jesus because (JESUS = Mormon Jesus). Pray that the spirit inside may intercede for his deepest groanings, that he may when he does reach for God, even if he cannot acknowledge the name of Jesus, that Jesus will be the name his soul knows.

Thank you, Liam, for showing compassion to Sean, helping him, and bringing his situation before us in prayer.

Let us pray that God protects him and provides the care he needs. Since his previous experience with Mormonism may have given him a false understanding of Jesus, let us also pray that his heart will become open to hearing the true Gospel.
Sean needs more than faith in “something.” He needs to understand who the true Jesus is—the eternal Son of God, Lord and Savior—why we are separated from God by sin, and why Christ calls us to repentance and faith in Him.
May the Holy Spirit remove his confusion, convict him of sin, open his understanding, and grant him a changed and repentant heart. And may God give us, or another faithful believer, another opportunity to explain the Gospel to him patiently, lovingly, and accurately.

Let us pray that Sean will come not merely to believe that God exists, but to know, trust, and confess Jesus Christ as Lord.

Liam, thank you for showing genuine compassion to Sean in the way you were able—by stopping to speak with him, praying for him, and helping him catch his bus. Your actions reflected the biblical call not to love merely in word, but in deed and truth (1 John 3:18).

Let us continue praying not only for Sean’s spiritual condition, but also for his practical needs. Jesus teaches us to care for those who are hungry, without clothing, sick, vulnerable, and alone (Matthew 25:35–40). James also reminds us that it is not enough to tell someone to be warmed and filled while neglecting what the body needs (James 2:15–16).
Therefore, if Sean is lacking food, clothing, shelter, transportation, medical care, or other essentials, may God give one of us—or another faithful believer—the opportunity and wisdom to help him or connect him with those who can.
At the same time, the greatest hope we can offer Sean is the true Gospel of Jesus Christ. Scripture teaches that people must hear in order to believe (Romans 10:14), and that salvation is found in Jesus Christ alone (John 14:6; Acts 4:12).
Because Sean’s past experience with Mormonism may have distorted his understanding of Jesus, let us pray that God opens his heart to hear the truth patiently and clearly—that Jesus is the eternal Son of God, that sin separates us from God, and that Christ died and rose again to save sinners, calling us to repentance toward God and faith in Him (Acts 20:21; 1 Corinthians 15:3–4).
May the Lord allow one of us, or another faithful believer, to cross paths with Sean again so that he may receive continued practical care and a clear, patient presentation of the true Gospel.

May the Holy Spirit remove confusion, convict his heart, grant him understanding and repentance, and place faithful believers around him who will walk with him—not only through words, but through genuine love, practical care, and truth. May Sean see the love of Christ through our actions and come to know the true Jesus through the Gospel.

Prayer Request 7/27/2026:

Requesting a prayer for this one. Atheist gentleman that I encountered in an elevator which is the funniest way of spreading the gospel cuz he couldn't literally outrun me. I asked him what book he was reading and he said he has a couple and I said "Bro, check this out" as I take out my little Gideon Bible and he told me "No thank you, I'm an atheist" so I said don't worry bro. I won't make you take the Bible. I just want to know what your thoughts are. He said he doesn't even want to talk about it. But the fact is he knows Jesus! 

I just want to pray that Jesus delivers him and this gentleman could be super smiling knowing that Jesus loves him. It was humorous to me because I was just able to share the gospel without having to really exert a lot of effort like some exorcism going on. This dude scooted to the side of the elevator and was trying to dodge me. I promise I wasn't even trying to force him to repent or anything 😭😭😭

I wanted to share a little thanksgiving/testimony today.
I wanna thank God for pulling me out of the darkness and now into the light. He does work wonders, be patient, keep pressing into His love.

Last night I was praying to Him, and I was half asleep towards the end, but I was telling Him just how incredibly grateful I am for Him and all the blessings in my life, and then I said that if every word I said was thanks and praise to Him, I would do it, because I feel that so strongly on my heart to do so.

This morning I woke up and opened my Bible as usual, following along with my daily verse, but reading the whole chapter instead of just the one verse. 

I kid you not, the first verse was this:
Psalm 34:1
“I will extol the Lord at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.”

I was in amazement seeing this, but knew it was from God relating to my prayer last night. 
Living proof that He hears our prayers and shows it through His Word, and other things around us too. Things fall into place perfectly through Him. Hallelujah my Jesus🙏🏻💞

Hey guys let’s pray for the families and first responders in the east especially in Spokane. If the smoke is bad here I can only imagine how bad it is for the residents over there. In Jesus name they will be protected!

Thanksgiving Announcement 8/4/2026:

As we are doing evangelism stand today with MOFT church, there are kids who came up, I gave them about 5 Bibles (one for each) and I'm overhearing their conversation between each other.

The oldest girl like 12 is saying she will be teaching the younger kids how to read and do a Bible study. So good to hear God's children are diving into His Word and the Holy Spirit is leading. Praise Jesus ✝️
